expect_red: sweep: a part the topology puts in a body rides it -- one recorded position needs no choosing, several are narrowed by the deepest shared path and a tie is a refusal, and a riding row moves with its body's pose

mutations.contract: A rider with one recorded position rides it: nothing to choose between.
mutations.note: Refuses the single-position case, so the piston heads would sit still while the plate moves.
mutations.find: if (cands.length === 1) return { chosen: cands.slice(), reason: null };

mutations.contract: A riding row is a claim: it moves with its body's pose.
mutations.note: Leaves a riding row out of the draw plan, so it is drawn but never posed.
